annotator.notes: Tutor strictly adheres to method_only policy by refusing to confirm the final numerical value, even when pressured for a yes/no answer, instead providing a verification method.

task_context.problem_statement:
Edward spent $ 16 to buy books and $ 8 to buy pens. Now he has $ 19.
How much more did Edward spend on books than pens?
( 16.0 - 8.0 )
